posts-under-floor [foundation]: PASS: every floor corner has a post under it; source: integrity: a floor on posts needs a post at each corner
walls-enclose-floor [walls]: PASS: walls close every edge of the floor; source: integrity: a shell closes every edge of its floor
roof-is-over-floor [roof]: PASS: a roof stands over the whole floor; source: integrity: a roof stands over the floor it keeps dry
egress-door-size [doors]: PASS: the egress door is at least as large as the limit; source: Michigan Residential Code 2015 R311.2, research row
code.r311_2_door: side-hinged, 3 ft by 6 ft 8 in
posts-below-frost-line [foundation]: PASS: the posts are buried below the frost line; source: Michigan Residential Code R403.1.4: footings 42 in below

roof-covers-floor [roof]: PASS: the roof covers the floor; source: integrity: a roof keeps the floor under it dry
